author: Chris Cooley
name: Byte Runner
tagline: Follow the bites. Eat the page.
description: A round, hungry pixel frog chomps through the webpage. Follow short food trails along text and gutters, grab glowing power squares, and chase a growing swarm of flies.
versionNote: Food trails. Tiny feet. A very real page.
controls: Arrows / WASD / touch D-pad — move through the page
Follow the food or leave the trail to eat page text
P — pause · G — next area · Esc — Recall

chapters.title: The UI is the terrain.
chapters.body: A few compact food trails follow real text lines and UI gutters. Pellets stay in whitespace; real letters supply the food on text runs. Leave the trails to explore and eat the page. Eat each square once to clear the level; returning food is a bonus.

chapters.title: Big glow. Bigger appetite.
chapters.body: Glowing pink power pellets turn flies blue for six seconds, stacking up to nine. Hunt them for 100, 200, 300, then 400 points. Cherries and strawberries appear on the trails for bonus points; fruit is optional and does not grant power.

chapters.title: Small feet. Big appetite.
chapters.body: A round, outline-free frog opens a wide chomp as it runs, with tiny scrambling feet that stop when you stop. Violet flies pursue directly, pink flies anticipate your heading, and cyan Roamers mix pursuit with wandering. All flies follow the same trails, even after the food is eaten.

chapters.title: The DOM carries the trails.
chapters.body: Eaten squares leave a faint grey trail. Regular food returns after 12 seconds and power food after 20, using the simulation clock and the same SVG nodes. Real text stays mutated until Recall. Trails and characters live inside the content root, so native scrolling and transforms carry them with the page.

extra: Three lives. Eat every square once to clear a level. Three flies arrive immediately, building to six on the first level and up to twelve later. Recall removes the creatures and food and restores game-owned text edits.

characters.name: Byte Runner
characters.rules: A round green frog with a wide, rhythmic chomp and tiny scrambling feet. Follow the short food trails, or roam freely and eat real page letters.

characters.name: Chaser
characters.rules: The violet fly takes a corridor route toward your position. Unpowered contact costs a life.

characters.name: Interceptor
characters.rules: The pink fly aims several junctions ahead of your heading. Turn to change its interception point.

characters.name: Roamer
characters.rules: The cyan fly mixes fast pursuit with roaming at junctions. Its wings stay within the corridor routes.

characters.name: Vulnerable flies
characters.rules: A glowing power pellet seals the gates temporarily. Blue flies flee along the maze and become edible. Chain catches for increasing points.

characters.name: Power pellet
characters.rules: Large glowing pink squares give six seconds of power, capped at nine when stacked. Six to eight are spread along the trails; eaten power squares return after 20 seconds as bonus food.

characters.name: Bonus fruit
characters.rules: Cherries and strawberries appear on the corridors. Catch them before they disappear; they are optional bonus food.
